decisions.reason: The premium raisin stollen draws directly on the firm's core confectionery know-how, has won gold medals from the Deutsches Brotinstitut in two consecutive years as external validation the firm can easily interpret, and is presented as a flagship, so dropping it would discard proven, well-absorbed knowledge.

The dark barley malt rye bread builds closely on the firm's established rye baking expertise and survived the 2024 pruning of the other specialty breads with its own page intact, which suggests the firm has read its early results as positive and sees it as part of its core assortment.

The marzipan stollen is a close variant of the award-winning stollen line, uses the same seasonal confectionery skills and recipes, and has kept its own page across both years, so it complements the flagship with little extra knowledge required.
